ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a ratio of approximately 3:1 relative to high-intensity (white/light grey) regions located at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity pigmentation covers the central and inner surface area. High-contrast, irregular high-intensity mottling and focal clusters are mapped to the distal extremities (tips) of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deeply recessed, acute V-shaped notch with sharp convergence at the center-line dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration characterized by multiple peaks and valleys (3-5 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing boundary, with a prominent deeper indentation on the inner portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory sweeping upward from the median notch toward the lateral tips, ending in sharply tapered, acute points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-intensity (white) circular pixel groups scattered across the dark-pigmented upper-central areas of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned light-colored linear disruptions visible against the darker pigmentation on the upper-mid sections of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration along the trailing edge suggestive of repeated minor physical trauma or wear; distinct deep indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast boundary between the solid dark central region and the heavily mottled, lighter-colored outer tips.
